provider: GitLab Package Registry (generic / npm / Maven / PyPI / NuGet / Conan)

free_tier.stated: GitLab projects have a storage limit for their Git repository and Large File Storage (LFS). Only the project’s repository and LFS are included in the storage limit. The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: Maximum file size on GitLab.com by package format: Conan 5 GB, Generic 5 GB, Helm 5 MB, Machine learning model 10 GB (uploads are capped at 5 GB), Maven 5 GB, npm 5 GB, NuGet 5 GB, PyPI 5 GB, Terraform 1 GB.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: The packages cleanup policy is disabled by default. When enabled it deletes older duplicate package assets and runs about every 12 hours, keeping the set number of most recently uploaded duplicates; the default setting keeps every asset. A rule can also delete generic packages not downloaded for 1 to 3650 days.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or volume quota is stated on the pages read. Anonymous pulls: anyone on the internet can pull a package from a public project.

tooling: Full REST API: PUT /api/v4/projects/:id/packages/generic/:package_name/:version/:file_name and GET the same path for download. Package clients can target the GitLab registry URL directly. No rclone backend, but generic-package PUT and GET functions as a standard HTTP blob API. Deploy tokens with write_package_registry scope provide scoped push credentials.
chaining: Package registry storage is not included in the project storage limit, which covers the project's repository and LFS (10 GiB for a Free tier namespace project). The number of projects per account and any project creation rate: unverified, not stated on the pages read.
limits_note: 5 GB per file for a generic package on GitLab.com; per-format maximums are in per_object_cap.notes. Packages API request rates and project creation rate: unverified, not stated on the pages read.

notes: Explicitly EXCLUDED from the project storage quota. GitLab docs, verbatim: 'GitLab projects have a storage limit for their Git repository and Large File Storage (LFS). Only the project's repository and LFS are included in the storage limit. The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.' The 10 GiB figure (pricing page: 'Storage 10 GiB') therefore applies only to git+LFS; package bytes are unquota'd. Per-file ceilings: Generic 5 GB, npm 5 GB, Maven 5 GB, NuGet 5 GB, PyPI 5 GB, Conan 5 GB, Terraform 1 GB, ML model 10 GB (uploads capped at 5 GB), Helm 5 MB.

extras.quota_verbatim: Explicitly EXCLUDED from the project storage quota. GitLab docs, verbatim: 'GitLab projects have a storage limit for their Git repository and Large File Storage (LFS). Only the project's repository and LFS are included in the storage limit. The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.' The 10 GiB figure (pricing page: 'Storage 10 GiB') therefore applies only to git+LFS; package bytes are unquota'd. Per-file ceilings: Generic 5 GB, npm 5 GB, Maven 5 GB, NuGet 5 GB, PyPI 5 GB, Conan 5 GB, Terraform 1 GB, ML model 10 GB (uploads capped at 5 GB), Helm 5 MB.
extras.limits_verbatim: 5 GB per file (generic). Package registry rate limits apply to the Packages API. Authenticated API traffic 2,000 req/min per user; unauthenticated 60 req/hr per IP. Project creation 200/day/user. No per-project package storage cap documented.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free and unmetered for downloads; no egress line item anywhere in GitLab pricing. Served through Cloudflare (probe returned Server: cloudflare).
extras.chaining_verbatim: UNBOUNDED on two axes: (a) unlimited free projects per account (GitLab Free has no project cap; only project *creation rate* is limited to 200/day/user) x 5 GB per file x unlimited files per project; (b) package bytes sit outside the 10 GiB quota entirely, so a single project is already a de-facto unlimited bucket and additional projects multiply it further. 10 TiB hot = 2,048 x 5 GB generic files, achievable in one project.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Full REST API: PUT /api/v4/projects/:id/packages/generic/:package_name/:version/:file_name and GET the same path for download. Also native npm/maven/pypi/nuget/conan clients by pointing the client at the GitLab URL. No rclone backend, but the generic-package PUT/GET is a two-verb blob API — trivial to drive from curl or a 30-line Python loop. Deploy tokens with write_package_registry scope give scoped push credentials.
extras.agent_focus: Package ecosystems as blob stores: npm, PyPI, crates.io, Maven Central, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, Conda/conda-forge, Hex, Pub.dev, CocoaPods, R, CPAN, Hackage — per-artifact caps, version-unlimited behaviour, retention/deletion policy

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
